blocks.html: Prior to installation of a flexible fabric sign, an affidavit shall be submitted to the Department in which the sign graphic producer shall attest that the sign was made from noncombustible fabric, flame-resistant fabric tested in accordance with NFPA 701 by a nationally recognized testing entity, or fabric bearing a UL Classification Mark obtained from the manufacturer of the fabric.
